lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab na hoi raam naam adhaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I have not taken the Lord's Name as my Support. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਖੋਜਉ ਅਸਮਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahu kabeer khojau asamaan ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, I have searched the skies,

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਸਮਾਨ ਨ ਦੇਖਉ ਆਨ ॥੨॥੩੪॥
lines.transliteration: raam samaan na dekhau aan ||2||34||
lines.translation: and have not seen another, equal to the Lord. ||2||34||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਰਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿ ਬਾਧਤ ਪਾਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: jih sir rach rach baadhat paag ||
lines.translation: That head which was once embellished with the finest turban

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਚੁੰਚ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਕਾਗ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: so sir chu(n)ch savaarahi kaag ||1||
lines.translation: - upon that head, the crow now cleans his beak. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਕੋ ਕਿਆ ਗਰਬਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: is tan dhan ko kiaa garabaeeaa ||
lines.translation: What pride should we take in this body and wealth?

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਨ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam kaahe na driRheeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Why not hold tight to the Lord's Name instead? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu man mere ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O my mind:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੀ ਹਵਾਲ ਹੋਹਿਗੇ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੨॥੩੫॥
lines.transliteration: ihee havaal hohige tere ||2||35||
lines.translation: this may be your fate as well! ||2||35||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਕੇ ਪਦੇ ਪੈਤੀਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee guaareree ke pade paitees ||
lines.translation: Thirty-Five Steps Of Gauree Gwaarayree. ||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag gauRee guaareree asatapadee kabeer jee kee ||
lines.translation: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Ashtpadheeyaa Of Kabeer Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਂਗਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh maa(n)gat dukh aagai aavai ||
lines.translation: People beg for pleasure, but pain comes instead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਹਮਹੁ ਨ ਮਾਂਗਿਆ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: so sukh hamahu na maa(n)giaa bhaavai ||1||
lines.translation: I would rather not beg for that pleasure. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਅਜਹੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਖ ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikhiaa ajahu surat sukh aasaa ||
lines.translation: People are involved in corruption, but still, they hope for pleasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੈਸੇ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaise hoee hai raajaa raam nivaasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: How will they find their home in the Sovereign Lord King? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਸੁਖ ਤੇ ਸਿਵ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਡਰਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: is sukh te siv braham daraanaa ||
lines.translation: Even Shiva and Brahma are afraid of this pleasure,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਹਮਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: so sukh hamahu saach kar jaanaa ||2||
lines.translation: but I have judged that pleasure to be true. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਨਾਰਦ ਮੁਨਿ ਸੇਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sanakaadik naarad mun sekhaa ||
lines.translation: Even sages like Sanak and Naarad, and the thousand-headed serpent,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਭੀ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੇਖਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tin bhee tan mahi man nahee pekhaa ||3||
lines.translation: did not see the mind within the body. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: is man kau koee khojahu bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Anyone can search for this mind, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨ ਛੂਟੇ ਮਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: tan chhoote man kahaa samaaee ||4||
lines.translation: When it escapes from the body, where does the mind go? ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਨਾਮਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee jaideu naamaa(n) ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, Jai Dayv and Naam Dayv

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਇਨ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat kai prem in hee hai jaanaa(n) ||5||
lines.translation: came to know this, through loving devotional worship of the Lord. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਨਹੀ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: is man kau nahee aavan jaanaa ||
lines.translation: This mind does not come or go.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: jis kaa bharam gaiaa tin saach pachhaanaa ||6||
lines.translation: One whose doubt is dispelled, knows the Truth. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਕਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: is man kau roop na rekhiaa kaaee ||
lines.translation: This mind has no form or outline.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: hukame hoiaa hukam boojh samaaee ||7||
lines.translation: By God's Command it was created; understanding God's Command, it will be absorbed into Him again. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: is man kaa koee jaanai bheu ||
lines.translation: Does anyone know the secret of this mind?

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਮਨਿ ਲੀਣ ਭਏ ਸੁਖਦੇਉ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: ih man leen bhae sukhadeu ||8||
lines.translation: This mind shall merge into the Lord, the Giver of peace and pleasure. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਏਕੁ ਅਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu ek ar sagal sareeraa ||
lines.translation: There is One Soul, and it pervades all bodies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੯॥੧॥੩੬॥
lines.transliteration: is man kau rav rahe kabeeraa ||9||1||36||
lines.translation: Kabeer dwells upon this Mind. ||9||1||36||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee guaareree ||
lines.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਜੋ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ahinis ek naam jo jaage ||
lines.translation: Those who are awake to the One Name, day and night

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤਕ ਸਿਧ ਭਏ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ketak sidh bhae liv laage ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: - many of them have become Siddhas - perfect spiritual beings - with their consciousness attuned to the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਕ ਸਿਧ ਸਗਲ ਮੁਨਿ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhak sidh sagal mun haare ||
lines.translation: The seekers, the Siddhas and the silent sages have all lost the game.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਕਲਿਪ ਤਰ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ek naam kalip tar taare ||1||
lines.translation: The One Name is the wish-fulfilling Elysian Tree, which saves them and carries them across. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਆਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo har hare s hohi na aanaa ||
lines.translation: Those who are rejuvenated by the Lord, do not belong to any other.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੩੭॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer raam naam pachhaanaa ||2||37||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, they realize the Name of the Lord. ||2||37||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਭੀ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਭੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee bhee sorath bhee ||
lines.translation: Gauree And Also Sorat'h:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਨਿਲਜ ਲਾਜ ਤੋੁਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: re jee nilaj laaj touhi naahee ||
lines.translation: O shameless being, don't you feel ashamed?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤਜਿ ਕਤ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੇ ਜਾਂਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har taj kat kaahoo ke jaa(n)hee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You have forsaken the Lord - now where will you go? Unto whom will you turn? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਊਚਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa ko thaakur oochaa hoee ||
lines.translation: One whose Lord and Master is the highest and most exalted

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਸੋਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: so jan par ghar jaat na sohee ||1||
lines.translation: - it is not proper for him to go to the house of another. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: so saahib rahiaa bharapoor ||
lines.translation: That Lord and Master is pervading everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sa(n)g naahee har door ||2||
lines.translation: The Lord is always with us; He is never far away. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਲਾ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kavalaa charan saran hai jaa ke ||
lines.translation: Even Maya takes to the Sanctuary of His Lotus Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਰ ਤਾ ਕੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kahu jan kaa naahee ghar taa ke ||3||
lines.translation: Tell me, what is there which is not in His home? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਕਹੈ ਜਾਸੁ ਕੀ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kooo kahai jaas kee baataa ||
lines.translation: Everyone speaks of Him; He is All-powerful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥੁ ਨਿਜ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: so sa(n)mrath nij pat hai daataa ||4||
lines.translation: He is His Own Master; He is the Giver. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਗ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahai kabeer pooran jag soee ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, he alone is perfect in this world,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥੩੮॥
lines.transliteration: jaa ke hiradai avar na hoee ||5||38||
lines.translation: in whose heart there is none other than the Lord. ||5||38||
